name: Encompass Partner Connect API
description: The Encompass Partner Connect (EPC) API by Ellie Mae / ICE Mortgage Technology enables technology partners to integrate with the Encompass mortgage platform. It provides endpoints for OAuth authentication, product registration and management, transaction processing, origin resource access, and transaction event management.
